description: This file defines constants, data classes, enums, and functions related to launching and handling assistant requests within an Android application for the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: HomeDestination
classes.description: An enum representing different destination screens within the app such as Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings.

classes.name: AssistantLaunchRequest
classes.description: A data class encapsulating parameters for an assistant launch request, including source, prompt, and autoSend flag.

methods.name: parseAssistantLaunchIntent
methods.description: Parses an Android Intent to produce an AssistantLaunchRequest object based on the intent's action and extras.
